# notes

A persistent, markdown-rendered note per session, edited from the Focus header and peeked from the rail card and tile header.

Read first: `docs/features/notes/spec.md`, `docs/features/notes/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/connection-storage-accessor-resolves-per-call` — safeLocalStorage and safeSessionStorage re-resolve the storage global on every call, so callers hold one accessor from init and there is one lookup policy. (accepted, 2026-10-21; features: connection, theme, reader, notes) → `docs/adr/connection-storage-accessor-resolves-per-call.md`
- `kb:adr/notes-blocked-storage-fixed-in-run-cycle-four` — Every dashboard localStorage access goes through the guarded accessor, so blocked storage cannot abort an event listener; fixed in a fourth review cycle. (accepted, 2026-10-21; features: notes, theme, reader) → `docs/adr/notes-blocked-storage-fixed-in-run-cycle-four.md`
- `kb:adr/notes-ended-row-sweep-takes-its-note` — A note lives and dies with its session row, so the start-up sweep of an already-ended row deletes its note; a restart keeps the note of every row it keeps. (accepted, 2026-10-21; features: notes, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/notes-ended-row-sweep-takes-its-note.md`
- `kb:adr/notes-escape-only-from-inside-the-panel` — The note panel reacts to Escape only while focus is inside it, so Escape typed in the terminal always reaches Claude Code. (accepted, 2026-10-21; features: notes) → `docs/adr/notes-escape-only-from-inside-the-panel.md`
- `kb:adr/notes-glyph-before-title-marker-on-repo-line` — The Focus header's note glyph leads the title and never gives way; a card's note marker ends its repo line, and a tile's sits before its context readout. (accepted, 2026-10-21; features: notes, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/notes-glyph-before-title-marker-on-repo-line.md`
- `kb:adr/notes-muster-owned-session-field-whole-text` — A note is a nullable session-row field carried whole on the Session object, set only by a whole-text PUT; blank means none, last write wins. (accepted, 2026-10-21; features: notes) → `docs/adr/notes-muster-owned-session-field-whole-text.md`
- `kb:adr/notes-popout-hidden-in-tiles-geometry-per-tab` — The popped-out note panel hides in Tiles and returns in Focus; its form, position and size persist per browser tab in session storage. (accepted, 2026-10-21; features: notes) → `docs/adr/notes-popout-hidden-in-tiles-geometry-per-tab.md`
- `kb:adr/notes-request-bounded-at-ingest-ceiling` — A note has no product length cap; the note request body is bounded at the 20 MiB ingest ceiling as a transport guard, answered 413. (accepted, 2026-10-21; features: notes) → `docs/adr/notes-request-bounded-at-ingest-ceiling.md`
- `kb:adr/notes-unsaved-text-kept-in-browser-until-acknowledged` — Note text musterd has not acknowledged is kept in local storage per session and re-sent on load and reconnect; an older kept draft may overwrite a newer save. (accepted, 2026-10-21; features: notes) → `docs/adr/notes-unsaved-text-kept-in-browser-until-acknowledged.md`
